claims.text: Intake of dietary fiber is inversely related to obesity.
Intake of dietary fiber is inversely related to type two diabetes.
Intake of dietary fiber is inversely related to cancer.
Intake of dietary fiber is inversely related to cardiovascular disease.
Intake of whole grain is inversely related to obesity.
Intake of whole grain is inversely related to type two diabetes.
Intake of whole grain is inversely related to cancer.
Intake of whole grain is inversely related to cardiovascular disease.
The mechanisms behind the reported effects of dietary fiber on metabolic health are not well established.
